visitorInterpretation: Michigan law and MDOT policy do not require a named designated park for every legal roadside stop; a legal, safe, fully-off-road stop requires the exact shoulder to be unobstructed, not posted against parking and consistent with bridge and traffic-control rules. Tourism instructions do not certify those on-site facts or ownership of the walking route.

officialLegalSources.finding: MDOT says it generally does not prohibit parking on the side of state highways, subject to narrow exceptions. MDOT and MSP may arrange location-specific official No Parking signs through a traffic control order.
Outside cities and villages prohibits parking upon the main traveled portion when parking off that portion is possible. Does not establish that any particular shoulder is safe.
Prohibits parking upon bridges or elevated highway structures and where official signs forbid stopping or parking, in addition to other location-specific restrictions.

State trunkline parking restrictions are engineering-survey-based traffic control orders signed by authorized MDOT and MSP officials and posted by official signage; survey checks shoulder width and pedestrian safety.
State driver manual independently warns never park on a bridge, in a highway travel lane when shoulder exists, or where prohibitory signs are posted.

tourismEvidence.finding: 2025 brochure names Warner Falls 46.43333, -87.59888 and suggests parking on right side of M-35 and a short walk west. Its destination coordinate is the waterfall, not a certified legal shoulder position. No as-built road condition or owner-approved foot route.

officialRoadsideParkLayer.finding: No MDOT roadside-park feature named Warner or within 5 km of the state-GIS natural falls point. The layer covers roadside parks, not every shoulder, scenic turnout, or other public view.
officialRoadsideParkLayer.seasonScope: Most official MDOT roadside parks closed October 29 2026, but Warner is not classified as one in the queried layer; do not assign that closure to the falls or the generic state highway shoulder.

parcelEvidence.finding: An August 2023 compiled parcel polygon intersected the GIS falls point and the older informal parking waypoint, marked land use Res. Land-use classification is not current fee title, an exact ROW/easement boundary or proof of public access, and cannot be translated into a private-property/trespass verdict by itself.
parcelEvidence.countySourceReviewStatus: Current county parcel-level owner/ROW at both banks and approach not independently inspected; county advertises online parcel lookup, so this remains a targeted future source path.

previousProjectDisambiguation.conclusion: 2026 MDOT July north-of-Palmer culvert and August county road MT/MP culverts do not establish construction at the south-of-Palmer waterfall.

nextEvidence: Obtain a current official site-specific M-35 sign/traffic-control order and roadside width/sightline record near the actual south-of-Palmer waterfall, and the county's current parcel/easement or managing landowner confirmation for an entire walking approach. Do not require a bespoke MDOT lot if legal off-road shoulder stopping is established under statewide law. No crowdsourced visitor proof.
